evidence.quote: to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity or adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition.

The efficacy of ZEPBOUND for weight reduction in conjunction with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity was studied in two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled fixed-dosage trials (Study 1 and Study 2) in adults aged 18 years and older.

The trial enrolled 783 adult patients (aged 18 years and older) with obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m^2), or with overweight (BMI 27 to <30 kg/m^2) and at least one weight-related comorbid condition, such as dyslipidemia, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, or CV disease;

Study 1 (NCT04184622) was a 72-week trial that enrolled 2,539 adult patients with obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m^2), or with overweight (BMI 27 to <30 kg/m^2) and at least one weight-related comorbid condition, such as dyslipidemia, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, or CV disease;
